findings.issue: Verb mismatch: jp has 会って ('meet'), but en says 'go' (= 行く). Sense-changing mistranslation; contradicts pt ('me encontrasse'), lit_en ('want (you) to meet (me)') and both expl fields, which all say 'meet'.
findings.current: I'd like for you to go.
findings.suggested: I'd like you to meet me.

findings.issue: Token array is corrupted: four stray fragments (お, 父さん, 誕生, 日) with null glosses are prepended before あなた, duplicating お父さん and 誕生日 which appear again later in correct position; concatenated token surfaces no longer match the sentence.
findings.current: お / 父さん / 誕生 / 日 (4 leading null-gloss tokens before あなた)
findings.suggested: Delete the four stray leading tokens; the dissection should start at あなた

findings.issue: Malformed punctuation: the parenthesis opened at '(the fixed form for advice' reads truncated and swallows the rest of the explanation, closing only at the very end; the pt version shows the intended full wording.
findings.current: no past tense here (the fixed form for advice. あなたは marks the topic, and the whole means 'the option of you going is best' = 'better for you to go'.)
findings.suggested: no past tense here (it is the fixed form for advice). あなたは marks the topic, and the whole means 'better for you to go'.

findings.issue: Unbalanced punctuation: a '(' opened inside the gloss is closed only by a stray ')' at the very end of the field, after an unrelated sentence about な; quotes and parentheses are mangled (en version is balanced).
findings.current: 'aquilo que você é hoje (graças a quem é?'. O 「な」 aparece porque おかげ é substantivo e precisa da cópula antes de 「のです」.)
findings.suggested: 'aquilo que você é hoje é graças a quem?'. O 「な」 aparece porque おかげ é substantivo e precisa da cópula antes de 「のです」.

findings.issue: Garbled literal mirror: 'quanto-a-o-quê' fuses the topic device (for は) with the question word 何 into one unreadable hyphenated blob, and the particle に is not rendered at all; lit_en shows the intended structure.
も ('also/too') is dropped in the English translation; pt keeps 'também' and expl_en explicitly glosses も as 'also', so en is inconsistent with jp and with the rest of the record.
findings.current: Your college years will soon come to an end.
findings.suggested: Your college years, too, will soon come to an end.
